note: Dimensional standards for lab-hardware interfaces. Every entry carries a source. Entries with verified=false were not confirmed against the primary document during authoring and must be checked before use.

slas-microplate-footprint.title: Microplate footprint (base outline)

footprint_length.note: Measured within 12.7 mm of the outside corners. Relaxes to +/-0.5 mm at any point along the side.

footprint_width.note: Measured within 12.7 mm of the outside corners. Relaxes to +/-0.5 mm at any point along the side.

corner_radius.note: Outside radius of the four bottom-flange corners (convex). A receiving pocket's internal fillet must be no LARGER than the minimum (1.58) or it bulges into the plate corner and binds; a sharp pocket corner or a corner-relief cut always clears. Do not size the pocket fillet to the maximum radius.

slas-microplate-footprint.design_note: For a pocket that receives a plate, add clearance per side on top of the maximum material condition (127.76 + 0.25 = 128.01). Check the pocket, not the plate.

plate_height.note: Datum A (resting plane) to the maximum protrusion of the perimeter wells. Secondary sources also quote +/-0.76 mm; consult the document before relying on the tighter band. Lidded and deep-well plates are taller and out of scope of this dimension.

slas-microplate-flange.title: Microplate bottom outside flange height
slas-microplate-flange.design_note: Three flange heights are standardised. A gripper or carrier that assumes one will drop plates built to another. Ask which the user has.

slas-well-positions-96.title: 96-well plate well positions

well_pitch.note: Centre-to-centre in both x and y.

a1_offset_x.note: Left outside edge to the centre of column 1.

a1_offset_y.note: Top outside edge to the centre of row A.

well_position_tolerance.note: Each well centre lies within a 0.70 mm diameter of nominal. This is a positional tolerance zone, not a +/- band.

slas-well-positions-96.design_note: Grid layout: x = a1_offset_x + 9.0 * column_index, y = a1_offset_y + 9.0 * row_index, measured from the plate outline corner.

slas-well-positions-384.title: 384-well plate well positions

well_pitch.note: Centre-to-centre in both x and y.

a1_offset_x.note: UNVERIFIED. Derived as the 96-well offset minus half the 96-well pitch. Confirm against ANSI/SLAS 4-2004 before cutting metal.

a1_offset_y.note: UNVERIFIED. Derived, as above. Confirm against the document.

slas-well-positions-384.design_note: Only well_pitch is confirmed here. Read the standard for the A1 offsets before relying on them.

well_pitch.note: Centre-to-centre in both x and y.

a1_offset_x.note: UNVERIFIED. Derived from the 96-well offset. Confirm against ANSI/SLAS 4-2004.

a1_offset_y.note: UNVERIFIED. Derived, as above. Confirm against the document.

cuvette-standard-10mm.title: Standard 10 mm path-length spectrophotometer cuvette
cuvette-standard-10mm.document: No single ANSI/ISO document fixes this; it is a near-universal convention across suppliers.

external_height.note: Body height excluding any cap or stopper. Semi-micro and micro cuvettes share the external footprint but differ in height and internal geometry.

path_length.note: Internal optical path. 12.5 external minus 2 x 1.25 mm wall.

cuvette-standard-10mm.design_note: Because this is a convention rather than a standard, a holder should be designed with generous clearance or a compliant feature. Confirm against the user's actual cuvettes.

optical-breadboard-metric.title: Metric optical breadboard hole grid
optical-breadboard-metric.document: Universal across Thorlabs, Newport, Edmund and others for metric tables.

grid_pitch.note: Metric grid. NOT interchangeable with the 25.4 mm imperial grid.

clearance_hole_close.note: Close-fit clearance for an M6 cap screw.

clearance_hole_normal.note: Normal-fit clearance for M6. Prefer this on printed parts.

counterbore_dia.note: For an M6 socket head cap screw head (nominal head dia 10 mm).

screw_head_height.note: M6 socket head cap screw head height (ISO 4762). A counterbore shallower than this leaves the head proud, not flush.

border.note: Typical edge-to-first-hole distance. A property of the TABLE, not of your part: your plate's edge margin is a free design choice, so do not declare this as an interface.

optical-breadboard-metric.design_note: Slot rather than hole one of any pair of mounting features to absorb grid and print tolerance.

optical-breadboard-imperial.title: Imperial optical breadboard hole grid
optical-breadboard-imperial.document: Universal across Thorlabs, Newport, Edmund and others for imperial tables.

grid_pitch.note: 1 inch exactly. Over four holes this differs from the metric grid by 1.6 mm.

thread_major_dia.note: 1/4-20 UNC: 0.25 inch major diameter, 20 threads per inch.

counterbore_dia.note: For a 1/4-20 socket head cap screw head.

screw_head_height.note: 1/4-20 socket head cap screw head height (0.25 inch). A counterbore shallower than this leaves the head proud, not flush.

border.note: Typical 0.5 inch edge-to-first-hole distance. A property of the TABLE, not of your part: your plate's edge margin is a free design choice, so do not declare this as an interface.

optical-breadboard-imperial.design_note: Ask which table the user has. Assuming the wrong system is the most common optomechanical design error.

cage-system-30mm.title: 30 mm cage system
cage-system-30mm.authority: Thorlabs (de facto standard, second-sourced by others)
cage-system-30mm.document: Thorlabs 30 mm cage system construction rods and cage plates

rod_spacing.note: Rod centre to rod centre, on a square pattern. 1.18 inch.

plate_thickness_typical.note: 0.35 inch, the CP33 standard cage plate. Informational, not a mating dimension: custom plates may be any thickness, but matching it keeps optical path budgets simple.

cage-system-30mm.design_note: The 30 mm rod square is centred on the optical axis. A custom plate must place its aperture at the centroid of the four rod bores. Bore diameter is rod_diameter plus twice the free-sliding per-side clearance for YOUR process (fabrication-limits.md): about 6.2 CNC, 6.4 SLA, 6.8 FDM. 6.1 is a reamed-metal number and binds on printed parts. Four bores on a common square over-constrain each other, so do not go tighter than the fits table. Declare the bore against rod_diameter with intent envelope and the clearance you chose.

sm1-lens-tube-thread.title: SM1 lens tube thread

thread_major_dia.note: 1.035 inch-40 thread. Holds 1 inch diameter optics.

sm1-lens-tube-thread.design_note: A 40 TPI thread has a 0.635 mm pitch, which is at or below the resolution of most FDM printers. Print a clearance bore and use a purchased SM1 adapter or a tapped insert rather than printing the thread.
